pairs: O people not worthy to be loved.
priusquam pariat jussio quasi pulverem transeuntem diem,
Until the decree settles accounts, the day like dust is passing away,
antequam veniat super vos ira furoris Domini,
before which the wrath of the fury of the Lord may overcome you,
antequam veniat super vos dies indignationis Domini.
before which the day of the anger of the Lord may overcome you.
all you meek of the earth;
you who have been working are his judgment.
si quomodo abscondamini in die furoris Domini.
in some way, you might be hidden in the day of the fury of the Lord.
and Ashkelon will be in the desert;
they will expel Ashdod at midday,
Woe to you who inhabit the coast of the sea,
The word of the Lord is over you,
so that not one inhabitant will be left.
Et erit funiculus maris requies pastorum,
And the coastline of the sea will be a resting place for shepherds
and a fence line for cattle.
et erit funiculus ejus qui remanserit de domo Juda:
And it will be the line of him who will remain from the house of Judah.
in domibus Ascalonis ad vesperam requiescent,
In the houses of Ashkelon, they will rest towards evening.
quia visitabit eos Dominus Deus eorum,
For the Lord their God will visit them,
and he will turn away their captivity.
I have heard about the disgrace of Moab
and the blasphemies of the sons of Ammon,
by which they have defamed my people
et magnificati sunt super terminos eorum.
and have been magnified beyond their borders.
Because of this, as I live,
says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel,
and the sons of Ammon like Gomorrah,
and a desert, all the way to eternity.
The remnant of my people will despoil them,
et residui gentis meæ possidebunt illos.
and the residue of my nation will possess them.
Hoc eis eveniet pro superbia sua,
This will come upon them for their arrogance,
quia blasphemaverunt et magnificati sunt super populum Domini exercituum.
because they have blasphemed and have been magnified over the people of the Lord of hosts.
The Lord will be a horror over them,
and he will reduce all the gods of the earth.
et adorabunt eum viri de loco suo,
And they will adore him, each man from his own place,
all the islands of the Gentiles.
you will be executed by my sword.
Et extendet manum suam super aquilonem,
And he will extend his hand over the North,
And he will set the Beautiful in the wilderness,
Et accubabunt in medio ejus greges,
And flocks will lie down in its midst,
all the beasts of the Gentiles.
et onocrotalus et ericius in liminibus ejus morabuntur:
And the pelican and the hedgehog will stay at its threshold;
the voice of the singing bird will be at the window,
with the crow above its threshold,
for I will diminish her strength.
Hæc est civitas gloriosa habitans in confidentia,
This is the glorious city, dwelling in trust,
Ego sum, et extra me non est alia amplius:
“I am and there is no one other than me.”
quomodo facta est in desertum cubile bestiæ?
How has she become a lair for beasts in the desert?
omnis qui transit per eam sibilabit, et movebit manum suam.
All who pass through her will hiss and wag their hand.
